scope: Add and validate a generated AC1024 inline TABLECONTENT parser vector in the existing DWG object-vector test owner.

implementation.description: The vector directly invokes DRW_Table::parseDwg on one minimal AC1024 inline TABLECONTENT frame. It checks bounded strings, one column, one typed numeric cell, style handle, parser completion and the exact table-tail cursor. The source-authored frame uses byte-counted UTF-16LE strings to exercise the current reader assumption; this is not producer-confirmed byte-layout evidence.

limitations: Does not validate dynamic object-type dispatch or full-file reading.
Does not establish exact producer string lengths/stream storage; the generated vector follows the current parser's byte-counted UTF-16 assumption.
Does not cover all TABLECONTENT field variants, merged-cell/style mappings, AC1027/AC1032, native consumer behavior, or support parity.
No external DWG/DXF fixture was copied, added, or committed.
worktreeStatus: uncommitted shared checkout; no files staged or committed
